title: OAEP execution receipt
description: Draft oaep/0.1 receipt (PRD §9). Level-0 structural verify: a signed agent claim that this execution occurred. This schema does not implement cryptography, Merkle proofs, TEE/zk verification, a blockchain, or a hosted verifier. Encodings marked unstable may change without a protocol bump until oaep/0.1 freezes.

version.description: Protocol version tag. Must be the string oaep/0.1 for this schema.

execution_id.description: Unique id for this execution. Typical form is a 0x-prefixed commitment; generation method is unstable.

agent.description: Executing agent identity (PRD §11). Receipts are signed by this agent.

task.description: Commitment to the task / user intent. Raw prompt is not required (PRD §25).

models.description: Models that participated. Empty if none. Item fields beyond identity are unstable (PRD §12).

tools.description: Tool invocations with input/output commitments (PRD §13). Raw I/O need not be public.

delegations.description: Child-agent receipts referenced by this parent (PRD §14). Reference encoding is unstable.

execution.description: When and where the agent ran. Environment string is unstable.

proofs.description: Optional attestations / proofs (PRD §15 levels 2–4). Shape is unstable; Level-0 does not require this array.

trace_root.description: Merkle root of the execution-event trace (PRD §10). Hash function and leaf encoding are unstable. Optional for Level-0 structural verify.

signature.description: Agent signature over the receipt claim (PRD §11). Canonical serialization and signature algorithm are unstable — this schema only requires a non-empty 0x-prefixed hex string.

hexBytes.description: 0x-prefixed hex. Length and hash algorithm are not fixed in oaep/0.1.

id.description: Cryptographic agent identity. Preferred form did:agent:… (PRD §11). Other DID methods may appear; method registry is unstable.

version.description: Agent software / policy version string. Unstable.

commitment.description: Commitment to task input (for example H(prompt || nonce)). Preimage is not part of the receipt.

identity.description: Model identity commitment (hash, manifest digest, or similar). Unstable.

fingerprint.description: Optional model fingerprint (e.g. Sentient Model Fingerprinting). Unstable.

version.description: Model version or revision label. Unstable.

input_commitment.description: Commitment to tool input. Unstable hash function.

output_commitment.description: Commitment to tool output. Unstable hash function.

receipt.description: Commitment to (or hash of) the child execution receipt. Inline nested receipts are out of scope for this draft field.

environment.description: Free-form execution environment label (runtime, TEE class, host). Unstable; not an attestation.

type.description: Proof / attestation class. Examples from the PRD: tee, remote_attestation, zkml, zkvm, signature, reproducible. Closed enum is deferred; this field is unstable.

proof.description: Opaque proof or attestation material. Encoding is unstable (string today; structured objects later).
